name: CITY_ELDERS
canonical: the ten elders of Bethlehem called as witnesses at the city gate, aged Hebrew townsmen of varied years, weathered olive skin and long grey and white beards, robed in plain layered mantles of muted brown and grey with simple head-cloths, standing gravely shoulder to shoulder to seal the redemption
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
